current: W1-W4 and integrated thesis remain working drafts. Source register has 45 entries (SRC-001–SRC-045). Dedicated multi-message linkage/steganographic-carriage analysis and package-boundary terminology are integrated into thesis §§7–8 and supporting research. Complete exact-status, terminology, image-reference, thesis heading/numbering and illustration-placeholder consistency audits.
defer: Actual diagrams until the argument and comparative evidence stabilise; text prompts only at present.
External peer-review preparation until a coherent thesis candidate exists.
Implementation, platform experiments, extraction tests, steganalysis benchmarks, formal proof and security audit.
invariants: Image carriage is a required research comparison, not a mandatory runtime route.
Orchestration is optional; model service roles separately.
Protected object remains invariant unless explicit authenticated conversion is defined.
No anonymity/security inference from carrier uniqueness, concealment or extra hops.
Preserve dissent, provenance and historical work; distinguish proposal from demonstrated result.
Fragment-set membership, redundant carriage, independent messages, conversation/session continuity, retries and cross-route copies are distinct relationships.
Endpoint-authenticated linkage needed for reconstruction is distinct from observer-visible or observer-inferred linkage.
Carrier extraction, set reconstruction, per-image concealment, collection-level steganalysis and event linkage are separate evaluation outcomes.
Package encapsulation is bounded route framing, not authentication; optional steganographic embedding is not encryption or authentication.
Wang et al. 2024 is a robust watermarking-based multi-image comparator, not proof of general steganographic stealth.
Ker batch-capacity results are bounded by explicit mathematical and observer assumptions.

source_review_detail.SRC-043: Full publisher HTML inspected. Fragmented text-file covert-communication framework; fragment numbers/content in images; each fragment redundantly carried across multiple images; majority-vote reconstruction. Core carrier method is robust DFT/DCT watermarking; authors distinguish watermarking from steganography. Author-reported results only; no reproduction.
source_review_detail.SRC-044: Full proceedings paper inspected. Batch steganography and pooled detection; fixed known batch, equal cover capacities, random selection and stated component-detector assumptions. Capacity relation is framed as a conjecture here; formal theorem is SRC-045.
source_review_detail.SRC-045: Full author-hosted IEEE paper inspected. Formal asymptotic square-root capacity theorem under equal cover capacities, shift-hypothesis detector response with regularity conditions, independent per-cover errors and batch size known to both parties. Bounds may be loose; no empirical reproduction.
